hooks.name: Code Cleanup on Save
hooks.description: Automatically cleans up code quality issues on save

action.prompt:
Review the file that was just saved for code quality issues:
- Remove unused imports and variables
- Consolidate duplicate code
- Simplify overly complex expressions
- Remove commented-out code blocks
- Fix inconsistent formatting or naming conventions
- Improve variable/function names if they're unclear

Only make changes if there are actual issues to fix. Preserve functionality and don't over-engineer.
